kids_areas.name: Chicco Baby Club
kids_areas.description: Dedicated infant nursery run in collaboration with Chicco. Features developmental sensory toys, infant-safe activities, baby-care facilities, and certified staff care.

kids_areas.name: Mini Club LEGO
kids_areas.description: Playroom featuring a giant LEGO food theme kitchen, LEGO and Duplo building bricks, crayons, a mini-cinema, and supervised group activities.

kids_areas.name: Juniors Club LEGO
kids_areas.description: LEGO play pits, gaming consoles, supervised sports tournaments, arts-and-crafts, and daily group STEM exercises at the Doremi Lab.

kids_areas.name: Young Club
kids_areas.description: A dedicated lounge designed for tweens equipped with PlayStation 4s, VR setups, foosball tables, and an interactive multimedia table to post messages on the club walls.

kids_areas.name: Teen Club
kids_areas.description: A circular lounge for older teens featuring a private dance floor, DJ mixing decks, beanbags, big-screen TVs, and gaming consoles (Nintendo Switch, PS4, VR).

kids_areas.name: Doremi Studio
kids_areas.description: A professional family-focused TV/recording studio where kids and parents can script, record, and star in their own video productions, game shows, and musical performances.

kids_areas.name: Doremi Lab
kids_areas.description: A designated high-tech laboratory classroom utilized for interactive youth programming, robotics, 3D design, and science/technology workshops.
